instruction:
Refit Studio Into Four Rooms

This task starts from /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and may use /home/user/Desktop/init_plan.png as a local reference image. Modify the provided model into a four-room layout and save the required output as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc, and /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc is at least 500 bytes.
2. /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 4 IfcSpace entities, 7 IfcWall entities, 1 IfcSlab, 4 IfcDoor entities, 2 IfcWindow entities, 6 IfcOpeningElement entities, 6 IfcRelVoidsElement relationships, and 6 IfcRelFillsElement relationships.
4. The IFC model contains 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcFurniture, 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcStair, and 0 IfcFlowTerminal entities.
5. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
6. The single IfcBuildingStorey is named exactly Ground Floor, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only.
7. The IfcSpace names are exactly Living, Kitchen, Bedroom, and Bath, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only.
8. Living has clear plan dimensions 3.60 m by 3.50 m, Kitchen has 3.60 m by 1.65 m, Bedroom has 3.50 m by 2.70 m, and Bath has 2.70 m by 2.45 m; each may be in either X/Y orientation with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
9. Each IfcSpace has geometry height 3.00 m with tolerance +/-0.05 m.
10. The slab is named exactly Base Slab, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only, and has bounding-box dimensions 8.00 m by 6.00 m by 0.20 m, in any axis order, with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
11. The wall names are exactly South Wall, East Wall, North Wall, West Wall, Partition 1, Partition 2, and Partition 3, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only.
12. South Wall and North Wall each have bounding-box dimensions 8.00 m by 0.20 m by 3.00 m, East Wall and West Wall each have 0.20 m by 6.00 m by 3.00 m, Partition 1 has 0.15 m by 5.60 m by 3.00 m, Partition 2 has 3.80 m by 0.15 m by 3.00 m, and Partition 3 has 3.00 m by 0.15 m by 3.00 m, each in any axis order with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
13. Main Entrance fills an opening in South Wall with opening dimensions 1.00 m by 0.20 m by 2.10 m, North Window fills an opening in North Wall with opening dimensions 1.50 m by 0.20 m by 1.20 m, East Window fills an opening in East Wall with opening dimensions 1.50 m by 0.20 m by 1.20 m, Door Bedroom fills an opening in Partition 1 with opening dimensions 0.80 m by 0.15 m by 2.10 m, Door Kitchen fills an opening in Partition 2 with opening dimensions 0.80 m by 0.15 m by 2.10 m, and Door Bath fills an opening in Partition 3 with opening dimensions 0.80 m by 0.15 m by 2.10 m; each dimension may be in any axis order with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
14. All spaces, walls, the slab, doors, and windows are spatially assigned to Ground Floor.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
